name: Spaceman Mini Infrared Induction Flying Toy Astronaut Style Aircraft Toy with Remote control Induction Flying Machine Automatic Flight Kids Toy
description:
Remote Control for on and off 
Size: 16.5 cm x 12 cm (After installation)
Color: Blue, pink and White 
Rechargeable and USB cable provided 
Insert the L propeller into the top hole on the left and the R propeller into the top hole on the right.
The propeller has letters facing down. (Kindly read the instruction from user manual)
Find the switch of the aircraft and turn on the switch (Slide left and right).
The aircraft started and the propeller began to turn.
Release your hand and use your hand to control the flight of the aircraft under the aircraft .
When the aircraft encounters a fall, restart the aircraft.
Stop flying : quickly grasp the aircraft by hand from the side and then turn off the switch of the aircraft.
This product is suitable for Outdoor use.
Material: ABS Plastic
